response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's conspiratorial framing ("The system is rigged. Wake up, sheeple") echoes the call to awaken in [T4-004421](#T4-004421), which uses "#WakeUpAmerica" and warns readers not to "fall for tricks like this," sharing the new post's theme of a hidden truth the public must resist. The viral-sharing appeal ("Share to expose the truth") also parallels [T4-002543](#T4-002543), which urges followers to "Spread it, speak up for America!" around its own hashtag campaign. A looser thematic overlap with systemic corruption appears in [T4-009173](#T4-009173), which speculates that "corruption in our justice system" must be "VERY bad," though that post is directed at specific media figures rather than a general awakening call. The new post differs in that it names no concrete issue, evidence, or policy target, unlike the more specific posts, and [T4-003068](#T4-003068) and [T4-009131](#T4-009131) share little beyond generic political tone.
